description: Rule (2026-09-14): new tests go in a sibling <module>_test.rs, never inline in the module. fz-21x.25 (PR #167, dcf745b41) landed before the rule and added five inline tests: src/ir_interp/dispatch_exec.rs (an_unresolvable_subject_misses_its_arity_question, in a new mod tests), src/ir_interp/backend.rs (entry_dispatch_decides_a_lane_form_tuple_from_its_lanes), src/compiler2/jobs/native.rs (entry_dispatch_decides_a_lane_form_tuple_from_its_lanes), src/runtime_type_predicate.rs (tuple_positions_answers_for_a_value_that_is_a_tuple_of_that_arity, tuple_positions_admits_every_arity_the_other_structs_axis_covers). Move each to the sibling _test.rs (creating src/ir_interp/dispatch_exec_test.rs, src/ir_interp/backend_test.rs, src/compiler2/jobs/native_test.rs, src/runtime_type_predicate_test.rs as needed, wired with #[cfg(test)] mod x_test;), give the helpers they use pub(super) visibility, delete any inline mod tests block that becomes empty, keep the lib test count unchanged. fz-kdt.137 (PR #169) starts src/ir_interp/backend_test.rs; land after it to avoid a conflict.
title: Move the inline tests fz-21x.25 added into sibling _test.rs files
